findings.evidence: Mathlib/Geometry/Manifold/Diffeomorph.lean:276-283 (`@[simp] coe_toHomeomorph : ⇑h.toHomeomorph = h`, `coe_toHomeomorph_symm`); Diffeomorph.lean:79-82 shows the structure extends `M ≃ M'` with only `contMDiff_toFun`/`contMDiff_invFun`, so no continuity proof is needed. In-repo precedent for exactly this shape: `unitSphereEquiv` (TauCeti/Geometry/Sphere/LinearIsometry.lean:49, a plain `Equiv`) feeding `unitSphereDiffeomorph` (TauCeti/Geometry/Diffeomorphism/Sphere.lean:91) with a single diffeomorph-level `coe_unitSphereDiffeomorph_apply`.
findings.fix: Make the underlying map a plain `Equiv` (drop the two continuity fields at 103-110), build `collarDiffeomorph` from it, then define `collarHomeomorph n := (collarDiffeomorph n).toHomeomorph`; replace `collarDiffeomorph_toHomeomorph` with `@[simp] theorem collarHomeomorph_eq : collarHomeomorph n = (collarDiffeomorph n).toHomeomorph := rfl` and delete the five `collarHomeomorph_*` lemmas. Mathlib's `Diffeomorph.coe_toHomeomorph`/`coe_toHomeomorph_symm` then discharge every homeomorph-level goal from the retained diffeomorph lemmas, keeping the diffeomorph API the API-design thread approved.
findings.issue: Ten characteristic lemmas state five facts twice: `collarHomeomorph_apply_zero/_apply_succ/_symm_apply_fst/_symm_apply_snd_apply_zero/_apply_zero_normal` (118-158) and the defeq-equal `collarDiffeomorph_*` copies (215-250), bridged by `collarDiffeomorph_toHomeomorph` which cannot fire (Mathlib's `@[simp] Diffeomorph.coe_toHomeomorph` normalizes `⇑h.toHomeomorph` to `⇑h`, i.e. homeomorph-coe rewrites *toward* the diffeomorph). The reply on the earlier thread is right that the diffeo lemmas cannot be derived from the homeo ones; the deduplication therefore has to run the other way. `collarHomeomorph`'s hand-written `continuous_toFun`/`continuous_invFun` (103-110) are likewise redundant, since `Diffeomorph` only needs `toEquiv` + `contMDiff` fields and supplies continuity via `Diffeomorph.toHomeomorph`.

findings.evidence: Model.lean:195-208 proves `((euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryNormalEquiv n).symm y).1 = euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryProj n y`, i.e. the two projections are literally the same map; Model.lean:41-51 vs 147-161 show `NormalEquiv n (x, 0)` and `euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryParam n x` agree on coordinate 0 and on every `i.succ`. `grep -rn euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryEquiv TauCeti | grep -v Model.lean` returns nothing.
findings.fix: Define `euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryProj n := (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ℝ).comp (euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryNormalEquiv n).symm.toContinuousLinearMap` and `euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryParam n := (euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryNormalEquiv n).toContinuousLinearMap.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ℝ)`, deriving `..._apply` / `..._apply_zero` / `..._apply_succ` from `euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryNormalEquiv_apply_zero/_apply_succ`, and delete the private `euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryProjLinearMap` (+ its `_apply`). `euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryLinearEquiv`/`euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryEquiv` then lose their only consumer (grep shows no use outside Model.lean) and should go with them.
findings.issue: Making `euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryNormalEquiv` public puts a third implementation of the same coordinate split in one file: `euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryProjLinearMap` (163, `Fin.tail`) and `euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryLinearEquiv` (73, `Fin.cons`/`Fin.tail`) hand-roll what the equiv now provides. The PR's own new lemmas prove the overlap, so the private plumbing is re-derivation rather than reuse — contrary to the PR description's claim that both consumers now use one coordinate split.

summary: The collar file carries two parallel characteristic APIs (five homeomorph lemmas and five defeq-equal diffeomorph restatements) plus hand-written continuity that `Diffeomorph` already supplies, and Model.lean now holds a third hand-rolled implementation of the same coordinate split beside the newly public `euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryNormalEquiv`. No duplication of Mathlib material was found.
